spans.s:
कुर् कुर्, cl. 6. P. कुरति, -रितुम्, to utter
a sound, to sound in general.

कुरका कुरका, f. the olibanum tree, Bos-
wellia Thurifera (= सल्लकी).

कुरङ्कर कुरङ्कर or कुरङ्कुर, अस्, m. the
Indian crane, Ardea Sibirica.

कुरङ्ग कुरङ्ग, अस्, m. (said to be fr. 1. कॄ),
a species of antelope, an antelope or deer in general;
N. of a mountain; (ई), f. a female antelope.
—कु-
रङ्ग-नयना, f. a handsome woman (‘fawn-eyed’).
—कुरङ्ग-नाभि, इस्, m. musk (formed in a bag
attached to the belly of the deer above the navel).

कुरङ्गक, अस्, m. a species of antelope, an
antelope, a deer; (इका), f. a kind of bean (= मुद्ग-
पर्णी).
कुरङ्गम, अस्, m. a species of antelope or deer.

कुरङ्गाय, nom. A. कुरङ्गायते, -यितुम्, to
become or take the shape of an antelope.

कुरचिल्ल कुरचिल्ल, अस्, m. a crab; (a wrong
reading for कुरु-चिल्ल.)

कुरट कुरट, अस्, m. a shoemaker, a leather-
seller, a currier; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.

कुरण्ट कुरण्ट, अस्, m. or कुरण्टक, अस्, इका,
m. f. yellow amaranth (पीताम्लान), and a yellow
kind of barleria (पीतझिण्टी); (अम्), n. the blossom
of this plant. Also कुरण्डक and कुरुण्टक.

कुरण्ड कुरण्ड, अस्, m. enlargement of the
testicles or rather of the scrotum, including inguinal
hernia, hydrocele, &c.; N. of a plant, commonly
called Sākuruṇḍa.

कुरण्डक कुरण्डक, अस्, m. yellow amaranth;
a yellow kind of barleria; [cf. कुरण्ट.]

कुरयाण कुरयाण, अस्, m., N. of a man;
[cf. कौरयाण.]

कुरर कुरर, अस्, आ, m. f. (said to be fr. rt.
3. कु), an osprey; also another species of eagle; (ई), f.
a female osprey; a sheep, an ewe; (अस्), m., N. of a
mountain.
—कुरराङ्घ्रि (˚र-अङ्˚), इस्, m. a kind
of mustard (देव-सर्षप).
—कुररी-गण, अस्,
m. a flight of ospreys.
कुरराव, अम्, n. a place abounding with ospreys.

कुरल कुरल, अस्, m. an osprey [cf. कुरर];
a curl, a lock of hair upon the forehead.

कुराल कुराल, अस्, m. a light bay horse
with black legs; (wrong reading for कुराह, which
is a various reading for उराह.)

कुरव कु-रव, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), having
a bad voice; (अस्), m. a bad or harsh sound; N. of a
plant, = सितमन्दार; a red or a yellow kind of
barleria.

कुरवक, अस्, m. a crimson species of amaranth;
a purple or a yellow sort of Jhiṇṭi or barleria; a
species of rice or grain; (अम्), n. the blossom of the
amaranth or of the barleria.

कुरस कु-रस, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), having
bad juice or flavour or essence; (अस्), m. spirituous or
[]
vinous liquor; (आ), f. a wild creeping plant, a species
of hieracium; [cf. गो-जिह्वा.]

कुराजन् कु-राजन्, आ, m. (see 1. कु), a bad
king.
कु-राज्य, अम्, n. bad dominion, bad administration.
कुरी कुरी, f. a kind of grass or corn.

कुरीर कुरीर, अम्, n. (said to be fr. 1. कृ),
Ved. a kind of head-dress for women; copulation.

कुरीरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. decorated with the head-
dress called कुरीर.

कुरु कुरु, अवस्, m. pl. (said to be fr. 1. कृ),
N. of a people of India and their country, situated
near the country of the Pañcālas (hence often con-
nected with Pañcāla or Pāñcāla; see कुरु-पञ्चाल
below); the Kurus derive their origin from Kuru (son
of Saṃvaraṇa and Tapatī, daughter of the Sun), who
is the ancestor of both Pāṇḍu and Dhṛta-rāṣṭra,
though the patronymic derived from his name is
usually applied only to the sons of the latter, the sons
and descendants of the former being called Pāṇḍavas;
another Kuru is the son of Agnīdhra and grandson of
Priya-vrata. The उत्तर-कुरवः or उत्तराः कुर-
वः are the northern Kurus, the most northerly of the
four Mahā-dvīpas or principal divisions of the known
world (distinguished Mahā-bh.

. from the दक्-
षिणाः कुरवः or southern Kurus), by other sys-
tems regarded as one of nine divisions or Varṣas of
the same; it was probably a country beyond the most
northern range of the Himālaya, often described
as a country of everlasting happiness, and considered
by some to be the ancient home of the Āryan race.
कुरू, ऊस्, f. a princess of the Kuru race. According
to native lexicographers the word कुरु has also the
following meanings; a priest; boiled rice; the plant
Solanum Jacquini, = कण्टकारिक; [cf. कौरव,
कौरवक, कौरव्य.]
—कुरु-कत, आस्, m. pl.
the Kurus and Katas.
—कुरु-कन्दक, अम्, n.
horse-radish, Raphanus Sativus (= मूलक).
—कुरु-
कुरुक्षेत्र, अम्, n. the country of the Kurus and
Kurukṣetra.
—कुरु-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. the field of
the Kurus, N. of a region or extensive plain near
Delhi, the scene of the great battles between the
Kurus and Pāṇḍus; (आस्), m. pl. the inhabitants of
this country, renowned for their bravery.
—कुरु-
क्षेत्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, with योग, a solar day, in the
course of which three lunar days, three asterisms and
three yogas occur.
—कुरु-चिल्ल, अस्, m. a crab; [cf.
कुरचिल्ल.]
—कुरु-जाङ्गल, अम्, n., N. of a
country; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the people inhabiting
it.
—कुरु-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—कुरु-
नदिका, f. according to native authorities, = कु-न-
दिका.
—कुरु-नन्दन, अस्, m. a descendant of
Kuru as Arjuna, Yudhiṣṭhira, &c.
—कुरु-पञ्चाल,
आस्, m. pl. the Kurus and Pañcālas.
—कुरुपञ्चाल-
त्रा, ind., Ved. as among the Kurus and Pañcālas.
—कुरु-पथ, अस्, m., N. of a man (?); [cf.
कौरुपथि.]
—कुरु-पुङ्गव, अस्, m. a Kuru
chief.
—कुरु-राज्, ट्, m. an epithet of Duryodhana.
—कुरु-राज, अस्, m. an epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira.
—कुरु-राज्य, अम्, n. the Kuru realm.
—कुरु-
वत्स, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—कुरु-वर्णक, आस्,
m. pl., N. of a people; or perhaps (अस्, आ, अम्), be-
longing to the race of the Kurus.
—कुरु-वश, अस्,
m., N. of a prince.
—कुरु-वाजपेय, अस्, m. a
particular kind of Vājapeya.
—कुरु-विस्त, अस्, m. a
Pala of gold, a weight of gold equal to about 700
troy grains.
—कुरु-वृद्ध, अस्, m. an epithet of
Bhīṣma.
—कुरु-श्रवण, अस्, m., N. of a prince.
—कुरु-श्रेष्ठ or कुरु-सत्तम, अस्, m. an epi-
thet of Arjuna.
—कुरु-हार, अस् or अम् (?), m. or
n. (?), N. of an Agra-hāra.

कुरुक, अस्, m., N. of a prince; (a various reading
for रुरुक.)
कुरुकुल्ला, f., N. of a Buddhist deity.
कुरुङ्ग कुरुङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of a prince.

कुरुट कुरुट, अस्, m. a kind of pot-herb;
[cf. सितावर.]
कुरुटिन् कुरुटिन्, ई, m. a horse.
कुरूटिन् कुरूटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. = किरीटिन् (?).

कुरुण्टक, अस्, m. yellow or white amaranth; a
yellow species of barleria, B. Prionitis.
कुरुण्ड, अस्, m. = कुरुण्ट.

कुरुतावि कुरुतावि, a particular high num-
ber.

कुरुम्ब कुरुम्ब, अम्, n. a kind of orange,
= कुलपालक; (आ), f., N. of a plant, commonly
called Droṇa-puṣpī; (ई), f. another plant, commonly
called Saiṃhalī.

कुरुम्बिका, f., N. of a plant, commonly called
Droṇa-puṣpī.

कुरुरी कुरुरी, f. a species of bird with a
plaintive note; (a wrong reading for कुररी.)

कुरुल कुरुल, अस्, m. a curl or lock of hair,
especially on the forehead.

कुरुवक कुरुवक, अस्, m. the crimson
amaranth; a purple species of barleria; also a yellow
kind; (अम्), n. the blossom of this flower; [cf.
कुरवक.]

कुरुविन्द कुरुविन्द, अस्, m. (fr. कुरु and
विन्द?), N. of several plants; a fragrant grass,
Cyperus Rotundus; a kind of barley, see कल्माष;
the bud of a flower?; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a ruby; (अम्),
n. black salt; cinnabar, or the plant Terminalia
Catappa (?).

कुरुविन्दक, अस्, m. a kind of Dolichos Biflorus,
a wild variety.

कुरुविल्व कुरुविल्व or कुरुविल्ल (?), अस्, m.
a ruby; [cf. कुरुविन्द.]

कुरुविल्वक, अस्, m. a kind of barley. See
कुल्माष and कुरुविन्द.

कुरुसुति कुरुसुति or कुरुस्तुति, इस्, m., N. of
a Vedic poet.

कुरूप कु-रूप, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), ill-
made, of an ugly shape, deformed, ugly; (अम्), n.
ugliness.
—कुरूप-ता, f. or कुरूप-त्व, अम्, n.
ugliness.

कु-रूपिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ill-made, deformed, ugly,
frightful.
कु-रूप्य, अम्, n. tin, (lit. bad silver.)

कुरूरु कुरूरु, उस्, m., Ved. a species of
worm.

कुर्कुट कुर्कुट, अस्, m. [cf. कुक्कुट], a cock;
rubbish, sweepings (?).

कुर्कुटाहि कुर्कुटाहि, इस्, m. a kind of serpent;
[cf. कुक्कुटाहि and कुक्कुटाभ.]

कुर्कुर कुर्कुर, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic
word), a dog or bitch; [cf. कुक्कुर.]

कूर्कुर कूर्कुर, अस्, m., N. of a demon who
persecutes children (perhaps cough or some similar
disease personified).

कुर्चिका कुर्चिका, f. the milky juice of a bulb-
ous root; a needle; (a wrong reading for कूर्चिका.)

कुर्णज कुर्णज, अस्, m., N. of a plant, com-
monly called Kulañjana.

कुर्द् कुर्द् and कुर्दन, incorrect forms for
कूर्द् and कूर्दन.

कूर्द् कूर्द् and कुर्द्, cl. 1. P. A. कूर्दति,
-ते, चुकूर्दे, कूर्दिष्यते, अकूर्दिष्ट,
कूर्दितुम्, to leap, jump; to play; [cf. Lat. ludo?].

कुर्पर कुर्पर, अस्, m. the knee; the elbow;
[cf. कूर्पर.]

कूर्पर कूर्पर, अस्, आ, m. f. the elbow; the
knee.

कुर्पास कुर्पास and कुर्पासक, अस्, m. a
sort of bodice or jacket for women; [cf. कूर्पास.]

कूर्पास कूर्पास, अस्, m. a cuirass or quilted
jacket worn as armour.

कुर्वत् कुर्वत्, अन्, अती, अत् (pres. part. fr. rt.
1. कृ), doing, acting, &c.; acting as a servant, an
agent, a servant.
—कुर्वद्-रूप, अम्, n. cause
according to the Cārvākas.
कुर्वाण, अस्, आ, अम्, doing, making, &c.
कूर कूर, अस्, m. boiled rice.

कूर्च कूर्च, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bunch of any-
thing, a bundle of grass &c. (often used as a seat); a
handful of Kuśa grass or peacock's feathers; certain
parts of the human body, as the hands, feet, neck,
and the membrum virile; the upper part of the nose,
the part between the eyebrows; the beard; the tip
of the thumb and middle finger brought in contact so
as to pinch &c.; deceit, fraud, circumvention; false
praise, unmerited commendation either of one's self
or another person, boasting, flattery; hypocrisy;
hardness, solidity; the mystical syllable हुम्; (अस्),
m. the head; a store-room.
—कूर्च-शिरस्, अस्, n. the
upper part of the palm of the hand and foot; the heel.
—कूर्च-शीर्ष or कूर्च-शीर्षक, अस्, m., N. of
a plant, a drug, commonly called Jīvaka, one of the
eight principal medicaments.
—कूर्च-शेखर, अस्,
m. the cocoa-nut tree.
—कूर्चा-मुख, अस्, m., N.
of a Ṛṣi.

कूर्चक, अस्, m. a bushel; a brush for cleaning
the teeth, a painter's brush &c.; certain parts of the
human body [cf. the preceding]; (इका), f. a painting
brush or pencil; a key; a needle; a bud, a blossom;
inspissated milk; (अम्), n. in त्रि-कूर्चक, scil.
शस्त्र, a three-edged sword.
कूर्चकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, stuffed, puffy.

कूर्चल कूर्चल, अस्, m. (?) an animal teething
for the second time.
कूर्चल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a beard, bearded.
कूर्द, अस्, m. a jump; N. of a Sāman.

कूर्दन, अम्, n. leaping; playing, sport, pastime;
(ई), f. the day of full moon in the month Caitra; a
festival in honour of Kāma-deva or the god of love,
held on the day of full moon in the month Caitra.

कूर्प कूर्प, अम्, n. the space between the
eyebrows; [cf. कूर्च.]

कूर्पासक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a bodice, a jacket
with short sleeves worn next the body, especially by
women.

कूर्म कूर्म, अस्, m. a tortoise, a turtle; the
earth considered as a tortoise swimming on the
waters; a particular gesticulation with the fingers;
one of the outer winds of the body; N. of a serpent
or Kādraveya king; the second incarnation of Viṣṇu,
his descent in the form of a tortoise to support the
mountain Mandara at the churning of the ocean; N.
of a son of Gṛtsa-mada, author of several hymns of
the Ṛg-veda; (ई), f. a female tortoise; [cf. Gr.
κλέμμυς, χέλυς, χέλώνη.]
—कूर्म-चक्र, अम्,
n. an astrological diagram.
—कूर्म-पित्त, अम्, n.
the bilious humor of a tortoise.
—कूर्म-पुराण,
अम्, n. the Purāṇa of the tortoise incarnation (one of
the incarnations of Viṣṇu) or the fifteenth of the
[]
eighteen Purāṇas.
—कूर्म-पृष्ठ, अम्, n. the
back or shell of a tortoise; (अस्), m. globe-amaranth,
Gomphrena Globosa.
—कूर्म-पृष्ठक, अम्, n.
the cover of a dish, a lid.
—कूर्मपृष्ठास्थि
(˚ठ-अस्˚), n. tortoise-shell.
—कूर्मपृष्ठोन्नत
(˚ठ-उन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, raised or elevated like the
back of a tortoise.
—कूर्म-राज, अस्, m. the king
of turtles, the tortoise supposed to uphold the world.
—कूर्मावतार (˚म-अव्˚), अस्, m. the tortoise
incarnation (of Viṣṇu).
कूर्मि कूर्मि. See तुवि-कूर्मि.
